headline: EPS higher year-over-year despite sequential pullback
summary_short: DLF reported Q2 FY2026 EPS of ₹3.21, up 4.2% y/y from ₹3.08 but down 37.3% q/q from ₹5.12.
summary_long: EPS of ₹3.21 rose 4.2% year-over-year from ₹3.08, but fell 37.3% sequentially from ₹5.12 in the prior quarter. This is the only KPI carried on the shard for this period; no revenue, margin, or balance-sheet figures are available from the wire feed.
